stories.headline: Tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital, Nasdaq CEO says
stories.body: Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman said tokenization could free up tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital.

stories.headline: Fed, OCC order Amex to overhaul AML controls, fine $350M
stories.body: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Thursday fined American Express National Bank $350 million after uncovering $13 billion in suspected illicit activity. The Federal Reserve ordered the company to improve its financial crime controls in a separate order.
